brief: A note-taking app in 3D space — recent notes float near, old ones drift away, connections are threads

dominant_strengths: Clean type hierarchy with confident weight contrast between titles and body, timestamps tastefully muted in slate
Restrained indigo accent on tag pills harmonizes with the deep navy canvas, giving a coherent nocturnal palette
Connection threads between cards hint at the knowledge-graph metaphor without overwhelming the composition
dominant_weaknesses: Spatial layout is flat and arbitrary — no real depth cues (scale, blur, parallax) so 'recent vs old' brief is invisible
Threads are thin straight lines that pass through cards awkwardly, breaking craft and suggesting no z-ordering logic
Static screenshot betrays no motion language; Depth Focus slider and Focus Mode imply behavior the layout doesn't deliver
fix_priorities: Introduce true 3D: scale, opacity falloff, and blur on older notes so recency reads instantly
Route connection threads with curves and proper occlusion behind/in-front of cards based on depth
Differentiate card chrome by age (border glow on fresh, desaturation on old) to reinforce the time metaphor
Tighten alignment grid or commit fully to organic placement — current mix feels accidental
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral palette is pleasant but behavioral affordances (depth, focus) are asserted in chrome rather than expressed in the canvas, leaving reflective payoff thin.
rationale.intent_fit: Partially — the cards-with-threads gesture toward the brief, but without depth, drift, or motion the 3D-space promise is unfulfilled.
